job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Trust & Safety)
job.pay_full: $195,000 – $255,000 a year base (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT); $173,000 – $233,000 a year base (all other U.S. states)

details.about: Affirm gives people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees. Its Trust & Safety Engineering team protects Affirm's consumers, merchants and network from fraud and abuse, building the real-time systems, risk signals and tools that stop bad actors without adding friction, working with data science, risk and operations. Candidates are matched with a specific team after the interview process.
duties: Own and deliver your team's quarterly goals, leading engineers through open-ended problems
Work with product management, design and analytics on ideas, technical constraints, risks and trade-offs
Spot project, process, technology or business issues early and lead in solving them
Support operations and availability with metrics, escalation and on-call
Set or improve code review and design standards, and share them through writing and tech talks
Help develop engineers on the team through feedback and guidance
needs: 4+ years designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale in languages like Python or Kotlin
A track record of highly available distributed systems with technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes
Experience defining the technical plan for a significant feature or system component, and writing high-quality code
Proficiency making significant changes safely in a large code base
A Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
details.benefits: Base pay $195,000 – $255,000 a year in the USA Pacific zone (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) and $173,000 – $233,000 a year in all other U.S. states; new hires typically start at the start of the range. Total compensation may include equity, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents. Also: flexible time off, generous holidays and a discounted employee stock purchase plan (ESPP).
notes: Remote-first: most roles can be done from almost anywhere in the US; new hires are invited to an in-person onboarding
Affirm provides interview accommodations for candidates with disabilities
